visible_condition: no actual physical wear shown due to promotional images
hidden_risks: actual physical condition and potential scratches or dents
screen condition including dead pixels or backlight bleed
verification of internal components (CPU, RAM, SSD)
response.best_proof: Photos of the actual physical laptop showing ports, chassis condition, and system info screen.
seller_claims_unsupported: actual working condition and physical state of the device
response.drop_reason: Seller used stock/promotional photos instead of photographing the actual item being sold.
response.failure_mode: Valuing the laptop based on pristine stock photos while the real physical item may be damaged, heavily used, or have different internal specifications.
